contamination_risks: Exact 2015-2020 date-symbol outcome pairs are globally untouched at freeze.
Warmup rows are feature-only and cannot count as promotion evidence.
The basket, single rule, target, and partitions freeze before provider access.
Confirmation remains inaccessible until an inspected development survivor is frozen.
family_contract.entry_rule: At the final completed session of an ISO week, require at least seven of eight ETFs above completed SMA100 and SCHG above completed SMA200; enter SCHG at the next session open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the fifth completed holding-session close.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry after the completed weekly decision, and flat within five sessions.
falsifiers: performance concentration in the best five trades
weekly cross-style breadth fails to produce stable continuation
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This dense weekly risk-on continuation rule uses cross-style trend breadth and a fixed growth target, unlike prior event, shock, oversold, pullback, residual, and cross-asset rebound families.
family_contract.mechanism: Buy liquid U.S. growth exposure only when completed weekly cross-style breadth confirms a broad risk-on regime, capturing short-horizon continuation without an event-capacity bottleneck.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Fresh quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timestamp, GTC protection, and before-open reconciliation remain mandatory.
family_contract.ranking_rule: The fixed target is SCHG and therefore has canonical rank one.
family_contract.selection_rule: One frozen rule and at most one weekly entry under all portfolio risk, notional, daily-entry, and capital-contention caps.
family_contract.stop_rule: Use 1.5 completed ATR14 below entry; missing data or an invalid structural stop produces a missed trade without substitution.

universe_requirements.selection_basis: Eight liquid U.S. growth, value, large-cap, and small-cap ETFs frozen before price access on disjoint date-symbol pairs.
